channel.title: The Times of Palestine
channel.description: News, context and stories from Palestine, in English.

item.title: In Nablus, the olive harvest begins before dawn
item.description: For families who have tended the same groves for generations, October means early starts, shared work and a harvest that is never guaranteed.

item.title: What we know so far: today’s key developments
item.description: Verified updates from Gaza, the West Bank and Jerusalem through the day, with the context behind them.

item.title: The fishermen of Gaza’s harbour
item.description: A look back at the port, its boats and the families who worked it, in photographs made between 2014 and 2019.
